adapter.description: Adapter the render was drawn on, from its `render.json`; null when it does not say.

all_sha256.description:
The reference film's archive pin (`references.toml` `all_sha256`) the score was made
against; null when the row pins no archive or the scorer was not told.

archive_conflict_waived.description:
The render read another archive than the capture played, and the run waived that
conflict; absent (false) when the archives agree or were not checked.

crates.description:
The `crates/` git tree the render was built from, as its scorer was told
(`stuntreel parity --crates`); null when it was not, as for a `crates/` with uncommitted
changes. A report older than the field reads as null.

credits_missing_frames.description:
Matched frames whose render record expects credits but whose render drew none
(no font, or a drawing fault); their captured ink is still scored.

excluded_frames.description: Matched frames below the fade floor.

i6_gate.description: Whether the scored mean reached each I6 threshold.

mean_index_agreement_scored.description: Mean index agreement over scored frames.

mean_loss_by_class_scored.description: Mean SSIM loss per class over scored frames.

mean_ssim.description: Mean SSIM over every matched frame.

mean_ssim_scored.description: Mean SSIM over scored frames; null when none scored.

min_ssim.description: Lowest SSIM over every matched frame.

sha256.description:
The reference capture's content hash (`references.toml` `sha256`) the score was made
against, as its scorer was told (`stuntreel parity --sha256`); null when it was not told
or the report predates the field.

sky_indices.description: Inclusive palette-index range of the capture's sky.

unmatched.description: Captured frames with no render on the other side.

AdapterClass.description: What kind of adapter drew a render.

oneOf.description: A GPU: any adapter that is not a CPU implementation.
A CPU implementation, such as lavapipe or WARP.

authored_fade_level.description: Fade level the film authored at this tick, when a sidecar was present.

fade_level.description: Fade level measured from the captured palette.

film_tick.description: Film clock the frame was matched on.

index_agreement.description: Fraction of pixels whose palette index agrees.

loss_by_class.description: SSIM loss split by layer class.

scored.description: Whether the frame reached the fade floor.

I6Gate.description: Whether the scored mean SSIM reaches each I6 threshold.

initial.description: The initial acceptance threshold was reached.

RenderAdapter.description: The graphics adapter a render was drawn on.

class.description: Whether the adapter is a GPU or a CPU implementation.

name.description: Adapter name as its driver reports it.
